description.zh: 加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The names of the accelerated domain names. You can specify one or more domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
- 停用加速域名后，加速域名的配置信息仍然会保留，但是阿里云CDN将停止为该域名提供加速服务，且该域名会被解析到无效地址“offline.***.com”，无法被继续访问。
- 如果您暂时不需要对某域名进行加速，推荐您使用StopDomain接口，暂停域名加速效果。
- 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
- 单次配置的域名数量不超过50个。
descriptions.en:
- After an accelerated domain name is disabled, Alibaba Cloud CDN retains its information and reroutes all the requests that are destined for the accelerated domain name to the origin.

- If you need to temporarily disable CDN acceleration for a domain name, we recommend that you call the StopDomain operation.

- Each account can call this operation up to 30 times per second.

- You can specify up to 50 domain names in each request.
